newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MGTS Russian Q1 97 pre-tax profit 145.1 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: MGTS Russian Q1 97 pre-tax profit 145.1 bln rbls.

text.p: Quarter ending March 31, (bln rbls) Q1 97 Q1 96
NOTES -- Figures prepared to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis. Full name of the company is Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set (MGTS).

State holding company Svyazinvest owns 47.67 percent of MGTS, the Moscow Committee for Science and Technology holds 33.33 percent, Bank of Bermuda (Cayman) Ltd 6.03 percent, CS First Boston 3.61 percent, and Credit Suisse 2.09 percent.

Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
